.step-badge { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1); border: 1px solid var(--border-accent); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 16px; /* Permanent luminous emoji icon visibility */ filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5)); transition: all 0.3s ease; }

/* Styled Range Slider */
    .range-slider-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; }

.styled-range { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 8px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--emerald-live) 0%, var(--blue-canary) 100%); border-radius: var(--radius-full); outline: none; cursor: pointer; }

.styled-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; border: 3px solid var(--cyan-cyber); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--cyan-glow); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s ease; }
.styled-range::-moz-range-thumb { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; border: 3px solid var(--cyan-cyber); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--cyan-glow); cursor: pointer; }

/* Particle Canvas Canvas Box */
    .canvas-container { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 210px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; }
.svg-gauge { width: 160px; height: 140px; }
.phase-bar-track { width: 100%; height: 6px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-radius: var(--radius-full); overflow: hidden; }

.log-terminal-window { background: #02050b; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); height: 280px; overflow-y: auto; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11.5px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 8px 0; position: relative; }
z_index_rules:
/* Interactive Drawer Modal for Stage Detail */
    .drawer-modal { position: fixed; top: 0; right: -520px; width: 500px; height: 100vh; background: var(--bg-surface); border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong); box-shadow: -10px 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); z-index: 1000; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; transition: right 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); overflow-y: auto; }
.drawer-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(3, 8, 18, 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); z-index: 999; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; }

fixed_height_rules:
/* Custom Scrollbar */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; height: 6px; }

.brand-icon-wrapper { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25), rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25)); border: 1px solid var(--amber-primary); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 22px; box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--amber-glow); position: relative; }
.status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--emerald-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--emerald-primary); display: inline-block; }

.node-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--node-accent, var(--amber-primary)), transparent); opacity: 0.8; }

/* Permanent Luminous Icon Badge */
    .luminous-icon-badge { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--node-accent, var(--amber-primary)); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--node-accent, var(--amber-glow)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; position: relative; }
.partition-chip .lane-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber-primary); }

.stream-canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 160px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: rgba(3, 8, 18, 0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.legend-color { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; }

.chart-canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 220px; position: relative; background: rgba(3, 8, 18, 0.7); border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); overflow: hidden; }
.gauge-svg-container { width: 180px; height: 110px; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.histogram-bars-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; height: 130px; padding: 10px 4px 0 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }

.hist-bar { width: 100%; min-height: 4px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--emerald-light), var(--emerald-dark)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--emerald-glow); transition: height 0.3s ease; position: relative; }

.cyber-slider { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 6px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); outline: none; transition: var(--transition-smooth); }

.cyber-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber-primary); border: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--amber-primary); cursor: pointer; transition: var(--transition-smooth); }

/* DLQ Table */
    .dlq-table-wrapper { width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); background: rgba(3, 8, 18, 0.6); max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto; }

.log-stream-box { width: 100%; height: 200px; background: rgba(3, 8, 18, 0.9); border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); padding: 10px 14px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

.code-viewer-box { background: #010409; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 14px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: #e6edf3; max-height: 240px; overflow-y: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all; }
z_index_rules: .chart-crosshair-tooltip { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: rgba(6, 13, 27, 0.95); border: 1px solid var(--amber-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 6px 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 10px var(--amber-glow); display: none; z-index: 20; white-space: nowrap; }

.dlq-table th { background: rgba(6, 13, 27, 0.95); color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; }
